name: Frank Chimero
role: Designer · writer · The Shape of Design
bio: Frank Chimero is a New York–based designer with a long public practice across brand, product, and creative direction. He co-founded Abstract and wrote, illustrated, and published The Shape of Design (2012). Essays and lectures are widely assigned in design classrooms; current studio work is listed on frankchimero.com and studiofrank.co.
highlights: Author of The Shape of Design; co-founder of Abstract.
Public essays treated as foundational web-design texts.
Studio practice spans brand and product direction.
